notes.title: Lucid Dream 2.0 Update
notes.content:
Lucid Dream 2.0 Update Announcement

Major Update List

1 Language support : Korean

2 Story Update

3 Past Episode play available

4 Steam achievement renewed




You can select between English and Korean at Main menu → Language 

After selecting Korean, Korean translation is available through additional interaction.

You can now select and play the episode you want.

Now when you clear an episode, your clear data is saved automatically

Any players who saw the ending in the previous version can now play the new episode

There is a change in dialogue at the end of Episode 2

Ending scene has changed

Lucid Dream only supports FHD (1920 x 1080) resolution

Other resolutions may cause unexpected bugs. Make sure you play in  fhd (1920 x 1080 ) 

To lower the difficulty in achieving Steam achievements, “Game Over” achievement has been removed

Added new achievements

There is no further plan for other language translations

Thanks and sorry for all the people who said they would help me translate

Sorry for the late update

Thanks for all your supports

Thanks for playing ‘Lucid Dream’
